m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: You insist? Then meet me inside Belle Regard, with your weapon of choice in hand.
'Tis but a scratch! I've had worse! No, no I haven't.
I have failed in my duty, and now my brother, Finn, will die! Why? For he is trapped herein by a Faerie's Curse.
A spell has been placed around the garden wall. If you breach the wall to get a rose, the tower will fall and kill him!
I have been cursed by the Faerie Melusine to stay in this tower until it falls.
I had heard stories of her wit and beauty. I surprised her at her pool outside Belle Regard. I wanted to talk to her, but I guess I scared her.
Could you talk to her and apologize for me? I'd do anything to show her I was a friend and get her to lift the curse!
Aah! Where did you come from? What do you want?
You need to pluck a Silver Rose from the garden at the tower of Belle Regard. You'll have to deal with the Black Knight.
Go to the tower of Belle Regard, and pluck a Silver Rose from the garden. You'll have to confront the Black Knight who guards it.
